copper-rockfish.name: Copper Rockfish
copper-rockfish.id_note: Coppery body with a pale band along the rear two-thirds of the lateral line; dark bars radiate back from the eye.

quillback-rockfish.name: Quillback Rockfish
quillback-rockfish.id_note: Very tall, deeply notched spiny dorsal; freckled yellow-tan head and forebody fading to dark brown behind; no lateral band.

yelloweye-rockfish.name: Yelloweye Rockfish
yelloweye-rockfish.id_note: Orange-red to orange-yellow all over with black-edged fins and a bright golden-yellow eye; rough ridges above the eye.

black-rockfish.name: Black Rockfish
black-rockfish.id_note: Slate-black back with paler grey mottling, whitish belly, large mouth and dark spots on the spiny dorsal.

lingcod.name: Lingcod
lingcod.id_note: Long, big-headed predator with a huge toothy mouth, long notched dorsal and brown-grey mottling flecked with copper.

kelp-greenling.name: Kelp Greenling
kelp-greenling.id_note: Slender, small-headed and small-mouthed, one long notched dorsal; male shown: grey-brown with blue head spots ringed in rust.

cabezon.name: Cabezon
cabezon.id_note: Huge broad head, scaleless marbled skin (green/red-brown), fleshy cirrus above each eye and on the snout, big fan pectorals.

red-irish-lord.name: Red Irish Lord
red-irish-lord.id_note: Sculpin mottled red, white and brown; spiny dorsal notched into a distinct front lobe; band of scales below the dorsal.

staghorn-sculpin.name: Pacific Staghorn Sculpin
staghorn-sculpin.id_note: Flat broad head with an antler-like preopercle spine; small first dorsal with a black spot at its rear; barred fins.

buffalo-sculpin.name: Buffalo Sculpin
buffalo-sculpin.id_note: Massive head with a long straight preopercle spine; row of raised bony plates along the lateral line; dark mottled green-brown.

shiner-perch.name: Shiner Perch
shiner-perch.id_note: Small deep-bodied silver surfperch with rows of dark dots along the sides crossed by three yellow vertical bars.

pile-perch.name: Pile Perch
pile-perch.id_note: Deep silvery-grey surfperch with one dark vertical bar mid-body, tall rear lobe on the soft dorsal and a deeply forked tail.

striped-seaperch.name: Striped Seaperch
striped-seaperch.id_note: Coppery-orange surfperch with about fifteen bright blue horizontal stripes and blue streaks on the cheek.

pacific-herring.name: Pacific Herring
pacific-herring.id_note: Slim silver fish with a blue-green back, one mid-body dorsal, no visible lateral line and a deeply forked tail.

pacific-sand-lance.name: Pacific Sand Lance
pacific-sand-lance.id_note: Pencil-thin, pointed silver fish with a jutting lower jaw, a long low dorsal and a small forked tail; no pelvic fins.

surf-smelt.name: Surf Smelt
surf-smelt.id_note: Slender olive-backed smelt with a bright silver side stripe, a small adipose fin and a forked tail.

starry-flounder.name: Starry Flounder
starry-flounder.id_note: Dark olive flatfish with bold alternating orange-white and black bars on the dorsal, anal and tail fins; star-shaped rough plates on the skin.

english-sole.name: English Sole
english-sole.id_note: Plain brown flatfish with a sharply pointed head and a straight lateral line that sends a long branch up along the dorsal fin base.

pacific-sanddab.name: Pacific Sanddab
pacific-sanddab.id_note: Small oval left-eyed flatfish, light brown with orange and dark speckles, big eyes and a straight lateral line.

sand-sole.name: Sand Sole
sand-sole.id_note: Elongate sandy-olive flatfish peppered with tiny black spots; the first few dorsal rays are long and free of membrane.

pacific-halibut.name: Pacific Halibut
pacific-halibut.id_note: Large diamond-shaped flatfish, mottled olive-brown, with a crescent (lunate) tail and a lateral line that arches high over the pectoral fin.

coho-salmon.name: Coho Salmon
coho-salmon.id_note: Bright silver with a metallic blue-green back; small black spots on the back and the UPPER tail lobe only; white gums.

chinook-salmon.name: Chinook Salmon
chinook-salmon.id_note: The king: big, deep, blue-green-grey back; black spots on back, dorsal fin and BOTH tail lobes; black gums along the lower jaw.

pink-salmon.name: Pink Salmon
pink-salmon.id_note: Smallest Pacific salmon: tiny scales, large oval black spots on the back and both tail lobes; males grow a hump.

sockeye-salmon.name: Sockeye Salmon
sockeye-salmon.id_note: Spawning colours shown: brilliant red body, olive-green head, pale hooked jaw (kype) and humped back; no large spots.

chum-salmon.name: Chum Salmon
chum-salmon.id_note: Spawning "calico" colours shown: olive body with jagged purple-magenta bars, white-tipped anal and pelvic fins, big canine teeth.

cutthroat-trout.name: Coastal Cutthroat Trout
cutthroat-trout.id_note: Olive-silver sea-run trout densely spotted above and below the lateral line and on the fins; red-orange slash under the lower jaw.

coho-smolt.name: Coho Smolt
coho-smolt.id_note: Finger-sized juvenile coho turning silver for the sea: faint oval parr marks along the side, big eye, dark-edged tail. Release it.

sablefish.name: Sablefish
sablefish.id_note: Long, smooth slate-black "black cod" with two widely separated dorsal fins, a straight lateral line and a forked tail.

spiny-dogfish.name: Spiny Dogfish
spiny-dogfish.id_note: Slim grey shark with scattered white spots, a sharp spine in front of each of its two dorsal fins, no anal fin and five gill slits.

bluntnose-sixgill.name: Bluntnose Sixgill Shark
bluntnose-sixgill.id_note: Huge, ancient deep-water shark: blunt rounded snout, SIX gill slits, a single dorsal fin set far back, glowing green eyes.

spotted-ratfish.name: Spotted Ratfish
spotted-ratfish.id_note: Chimaera with a rabbit-like face and tooth plates, huge green eyes, a venomous spine before the tall first dorsal, white spots, big wing-like pectorals and a whip tail.

wolf-eel.name: Wolf Eel
wolf-eel.id_note: Not an eel: a huge-headed wolffish with heavy lips and crushing jaws, long tapering body fringed by one continuous dorsal fin, grey with dark ringed spots.

bay-pipefish.name: Bay Pipefish
bay-pipefish.id_note: Seahorse relative stretched straight: long tube snout, armoured ringed body, small dorsal fin and a tiny fan tail; green-brown like eelgrass.

dungeness-crab.name: Dungeness Crab
dungeness-crab.id_note: Shown from above: broad purple-brown shell with ten small teeth on each front edge (the last one largest) and white-tipped claws without dark tips.

oarfish.name: Giant Oarfish
oarfish.id_note: Legendary ribbon of silver: an endless red dorsal fin, a red crest plume over the head and long oar-tipped pelvic rays.

unknown-fish.name: Unknown Fish
unknown-fish.id_note: Generic placeholder fish for species without art yet (and for "???" entries).
